case.must_observe.1.rationale: All canonical payload hashes match after root normalization. Claude has 48 files and only the explicit agents/openai.yaml exclusion; ChatGPT and Universal have all 49. No business resource divergence is observed.

case.must_observe.2.rationale: The new external-process-control-libraries reference and control-baseline-comparison template exist in canonical and every normalized archive. The complete 49-file inventory contains no docs/phase-1, phase-3 fixtures, tests or evidence payload in runtime.

case.must_observe.3.rationale: Archive roots match the release manifest; all entries are regular safe paths, no traversal, duplicate normalized aliases or symlinks, and CRC checks pass.

case.must_not_observe.1.rationale: Three distinct archive SHA-256 values are expected from root/metadata layout differences and remain checksum-verified. The checker compares normalized file bytes against the canonical allowlist rather than treating whole-ZIP differences as business-content gaps.

limitations: Actual static checks plus root content review; not model behavior, installation, platform verification or third-party assurance.
ZIPs intentionally have different root/metadata/hash. Content parity is normalized per manifest, not whole-archive equality.
Bounded pattern scan and provenance review do not certify absence of every secret, malware or third-party-rights issue.
